ns2:section.sectionText: By engaging in a competitive simulation, students will be introduced to the business functions of finance, marketing, operations, research and design, and their strategic integration for business success. In addition, a focus on important soft skills will enhance the students? capacity as a professional. Finally, the course is designed to engage and build students to become the next business leaders. Contact the instructor, Jim Dahl, at jgdahl@illinois.edu if you are interested in this course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore class standing.
